summary: This RFC defines a P flag in the Prefix Information Option of IPv6 Router Advertisements. It tells clients that the network prefers the deployment model in RFC 9663, where a client uses DHCPv6 prefix delegation, instead of building individual addresses with SLAAC from the on-link prefix.

eli5.summary: A router can put up a sign saying "ask me for your own block of addresses" instead of "just pick one for yourself." The P flag is that sign.

questions: how does a router signal dhcpv6 pd availability
